# bc7enc and rgbcx

The BC7 (modes 1 and 6) and BC1 to BC5 block encoders of Richard Geldreich's bc7enc_rdo,
https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc_rdo at commit b9438627eef73a1157e84201b6fa6eb2ffd6d9f0, unchanged: `bc7enc.cpp`,
`bc7enc.h`, `rgbcx.cpp`, `rgbcx.h`, `rgbcx_table4_small.h` (built with `RGBCX_USE_SMALLER_TABLES`). MIT or public
domain (`LICENSE`). Only the cooker links it (`ohao/cook`); approved by Frank, 2026-11-11.

Why this one, measured on OHAO's textures: `docs/plans/2026-11-11-step5-assets.md`, 5e.
